prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: desert dune sand, cool moonlit beige with fine wind ripples and a few small stones The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable game ground texture, pixel art for a top-down JRPG map: desert dune sand, cool moonlit beige BASE PALETTE (not dark or illuminated), fine low-relief wind ripples and a sparse few tiny embedded stones. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed pixels, crisp uniformly sized square pixels throughout, visually chunky pixels, about 256 by 256 ART pixels, with enlarged pixel blocks approx 7-8 screen pixels each. Hard pixel edges only: no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photo texture, random noise or checkerboard dithering. Deliberate clusters of 3–10 pixels with readable shapes, 4–6 earthy hue-shifted sand shades, warmer yellow highlights and slightly saturated purple-red undertone shadows. Classic top-down orthographic RPG map, overhead steep angle, no perspective. Neutral soft even upper-left ambient overcast-evening lighting; absolutely no cast shadows, night darkening, lights, glow, vignette. Surface only filling the entire square edge-to-edge, no border, frame, items, characters, text, large focal feature. Detail evenly distributed and understated. CRITICAL: truly seamless periodic repeat: exact continuity of sand hues and ripple contours across left/right edges and top/bottom edges, suitable for repeated tiled game map.
